2026_05_DEN_LAC.headline: Denver’s defensive pressure tests the Chargers’ protection plan
2026_05_DEN_LAC.paragraph1: Denver and Los Angeles meet in a divisional matchup where familiarity makes protection adjustments especially important. The Broncos must generate disruption without surrendering easy throws, while the Chargers need to establish manageable downs so their quarterback is not forced into predictable passing situations. Both teams can change the game through field position and red-zone execution, rather than relying exclusively on explosive plays. The decisive tactical battle is whether Denver’s front can dictate the pace or Los Angeles can neutralize pressure with quick decisions and a credible rushing threat.
2026_05_DEN_LAC.model_rationale: The Broncos need pressure to produce hurried decisions, but the Chargers can blunt that advantage by avoiding obvious passing downs. Early-down efficiency and field position should determine the game’s shape.
